meta.title: UNICO ROOM — Natural Living | K3V SHINJUKU GYOEN
meta.description: Solid wood furniture and soft Nordic textiles by UNICO. A natural room for guests who want to settle in, not just stay over.

unico.name: ROOM 01
unico.subtitle: Natural Living
unico.lead: A natural room by UNICO, layering solid-wood furniture with the softness of Nordic fabrics. A quiet that never grows tiresome, for those staying as if they lived here.
story: Solid wood furniture sits at the center of this room, catching the light that comes through the window. UNICO's pieces are all about wood that grows more comfortable the more you use it — ideal if you want a trip that still feels like home.
Nordic textile cushions and throws warm up the cooler morning light. Coffee by the window in the morning, soft lamplight in the evening — the rhythm of the day just seems to fit here.

highlights.title: Solid wood furniture
highlights.text: A UNICO dining table and chairs bring the warmth of real wood into the room.

highlights.title: Nordic textiles
highlights.text: Cushions and throws in soft tones shift character with the light throughout the day.

highlights.title: A calm worth staying in
highlights.text: Comfort over flash — a space that lets you unwind, whether for one night or one week.

specs.label: Amenities
specs.value: Full set of daily appliances — AC, Wi-Fi, washer and more

designerQuote.quote: We want guests to relax even more than they do at home, so we didn't compromise on the furniture. The UNICO sofa was chosen for a firmness that stays comfortable no matter how many hours you sit.
designerQuote.name: K3V Design Team

meta.title: JOURNAL STANDARD FURNITURE ROOM — Urban Vintage | K3V SHINJUKU GYOEN
meta.description: Well-worn leather and brass by JOURNAL STANDARD FURNITURE. An urban-vintage room for guests who love design and a night that fits the city.

journal-standard-furniture.name: ROOM 02
journal-standard-furniture.subtitle: Urban Vintage
journal-standard-furniture.lead: A room built around well-worn leather, brass, and furniture from JOURNAL STANDARD FURNITURE. A little bolder, for those who want an evening that fits the city night.
story: Worn-in leather and brass details take center stage here. Furniture from JOURNAL STANDARD FURNITURE is chosen for the character that only comes with age — a texture new furniture simply can't fake.
We wanted a room that looks good from every angle, on camera or off. It suits guests who love design and fashion, or just want an evening that matches the city outside.

highlights.title: Leather that gets better with age
highlights.text: JOURNAL STANDARD FURNITURE sofas and chairs bring in that well-worn texture.

highlights.title: Brass details
highlights.text: From lighting to hardware, brass accents run through every small detail.

highlights.title: Photogenic from every angle
highlights.text: A room built for guests who love design and fashion.

specs.label: Amenities
specs.value: Full set of daily appliances — AC, Wi-Fi, washer and more

designerQuote.quote: The texture of aged leather is something brand-new furniture can never fake. Choosing pieces with real wear is exactly what gives this room its sense of calm.
designerQuote.name: K3V Design Team

meta.title: Meet the Designer | K3V SHINJUKU GYOEN
meta.description: Why this furniture? The story behind the choices for UNICO, JOURNAL STANDARD FURNITURE, and CRASH GATE.

meetDesigner.intro: Each of K3V SHINJUKU GYOEN's three rooms was built with a different furniture brand. We didn't compromise on any of it, because we want guests to relax even more here than they do at home.

notes.quote: We chose the UNICO sofa for a firmness that never tires you out, no matter how long you sit. Wood furniture only gets better with use — the longer you stay, the more you'll feel it.
The texture of aged leather is something brand-new furniture can never fake. Going a little bolder gave the room a sense of calm that fits the city night.
Raw materials, but still a seat you actually want to sink into — that's the balance we're chasing. Details are coming soon.

meetDesigner.closingHeading: That's why you'll want to stay here.
meetDesigner.closing: Real furniture, not just a cheap place to sleep. That's the kind of stay K3V SHINJUKU GYOEN is built around.

stayPage.intro: A stay at K3V SHINJUKU GYOEN isn't a break between sightseeing — it's Tokyo life itself. Start by checking availability for the room that catches your eye.

availability.heading: Availability & Booking
availability.description: All three rooms are fully independent units, so there's no shared space with other guests. Once you've picked a room, just reach out below.
availability.pendingNote: Our online booking system is still in the works. In the meantime, send us your dates and we'll check availability and get back to you directly.

plans.heading: A plan for the way you travel.
plans.description: We've shaped a few ways to stay, depending on what kind of trip this is.

items.title: Long Stay Plan
items.text: A week, a month — the longer you stay, the more you'll appreciate having your own kitchen and washer. Settle in and let Tokyo become part of your everyday.

items.title: Family Stay
items.text: The whole unit is yours, so kids can be kids without worrying about anyone else. Cook a simple meal in the kitchen, relax in the living room — just your family's time.

items.title: Business Stay
items.text: Walking distance from Shinjuku Station, with Wi-Fi throughout. A quieter kind of calm than a hotel room, for the evenings between meetings.

steps.title: Choose a room
steps.text: Pick the room that fits you — UNICO, JOURNAL STANDARD FURNITURE, or CRASH GATE.
